notes.title: Patch #2.0 - Final Patch
notes.content:
Changes and fixes in this patch:

Added more controls to the Dynamic HUD
Fixed Dialogue Typos
Fixed the UI of the credits (and added more people)
Audio was improved
Bar was renamed on the Map as Drunks and Dunks
Fixed UI overlapping bug in the Publishboard
We made it so the testimonies can only be saved only if someone else other than you is talking


Thank you to everyone who played our game. Unfortunately, this is where we have to say goodbye, official support for this game will end with this patch.

The game will stay up on steam so this doesn't have to be YOUR final print :)

notes.title: The Final Print - The Talkie Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the final content update for The Final Print!

Our whole team is grateful for the amazing feedback from the people who played our game, but unfortunately all good things come to an end.

You'll still get some more patches, but this is the last major content update.



Additions: 

Voice acting!

Added missing animations

 Improvements: 

Better textures on models

More hint popups and tutorials

Better UI textures and better UX

 Bugfixes: 

Any known softlocks or game breaking bugs have been patched

Proper animations play in the bar

Fixed broken textures

Game doesn't randomly crash after the confrontation in the alley

Small issues with settings



Say hello once again to the same characters you know and love, who can now also talk to you, and with new and improved models:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554653/9c87c52c81e45946bf500bb027513ed7f5f58856.jpg"]

notes.title: The Final Print - Patch #1.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

Resolved a soft lock issue that could occur during the publishing process, ensuring smoother progression for all players.
Fixed an audio bug where sound effects would play while the UI was open, preventing unintended audio overlap during menu navigation.
Corrected an issue with the end-of-game newspaper, which previously displayed incorrect images. The newspaper now shows the appropriate pictures.
Addressed a problem where the Testimony Saving audio would no longer play in the bar, restoring the intended audio feedback for this action.
Fixed an issue where Wesley answering the phone call would keep the screen blurry until you talk to another Character.

notes.title: The Final Print - Patch #1
notes.content:
Bugfixes

 Fixed two softlocks

 Spamming E on the lighter while the camera tutorial pops up locks the game in that state until it's restarted
 Reaching one of the endings was impossible when using one of the possible evidence photos

 Fixed typos in dialogue
 Fixed issues with the journal, publishing, pinboard and other UI elements
 Fixed hints sometimes not showing up
 Other small non-game-breaking bugs


Improvements

 Better onboarding
 Small improvements to lighting
 Narrative changes to make things clearer/easier to understand
 Better mixing in some sounds
 Better hints
 Better experience on existing UI


Additions

 More sound effects
 Photos and testimonies stay on the pinboard after leaving the newspaper office
 New small UI elements to help with accessibility
 More hints
